summary: Independent review of 8-row x 29-column ms-proteomics v1.1.0 SDRF (2 OMV + 2 SyBV E. coli vesicle preparations, each injected twice). Validator, structure, offline term check all clean; every controlled term resolves; file mapping and replicate structure are supported by RAW-header sample names, deposited .msf names and Methods 2.3/2.4/2.8/2.9. Only minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent without producer transcript; read only annotations/PXD025421.* and scratchpad/PXD025421/; producer report/evidence treated as untrusted and re-checked against raw sources

spec_compliance.evidence: Only applicable template is ms-proteomics 1.1.0 (no prokaryote/sample-layer template exists in templates.yaml; human/vertebrates/invertebrates/plants/cell-lines do not apply). All 9 lines have 29 fields, no CR or stray whitespace; required columns present; reserved words used correctly (organism part/cell type/disease 'not applicable', strain 'not available'); collision energy '30% NCE' matches template pattern; comment[label] 'label free sample' is a template example value; material type 'whole organism' is in the fixed value list and matches the SAMPLE-GUIDELINES 'E. coli culture' example; factor value[sample preparation] has a matching characteristics column.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Resolved in offline cache with matching label and family: NCBITaxon:562 escherichia coli; MS:1002416 orbitrap fusion; PRIDE:0000627 data-dependent acquisition; MS:1001251 trypsin; MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation (HCD canonical); UNIMOD:39 methylthio; UNIMOD:35 oxidation; MS:1002038 label free sample. Free-text values are confined to custom columns cellular component / sample preparation.

source_evidence.evidence: pride.json (accession PXD025421): instrument MS:1002416, organism NEWT:562, protocol 'Two biological replicates of SyBV and OMV ... injected in duplicates', Mascot 5 ppm / 0.5 Da, 1 missed cleavage, Ox(M) variable, methylthiolation(C) fixed. manuscript.txt (PMC8254025, PXD025421 cited in 2.9): same parameters; HCD collision energy 30; SyBV = 'artificial OMV' purified on iodixanol (OptiPrep) gradient; natural OMV resuspended in PBS. RAW headers (evidence/raw_header_check.json): Orbitrap Fusion, ActivationType=HCD, Collision Energy (%)=30, non-stepped, DDA. No strain or reduction/alkylation reagent stated anywhere in saved evidence, so 'not available' / omission is correct.

file_mapping.evidence: files_compact.json (all FTP paths under .../PXD025421/) lists exactly 8 RAW files Fusion_180709_111/112/115/116/119/120/123/124.raw; SDRF comment[data file] lists the same 8, each once, no non-RAW files. Per-file mapping verified against deposited .msf names: OMV-PBS-inj1/2=111/112, OMV-b2-PBS-inj1/2=115/116, aOMV-Opti-inj1/2=119/120, aOMV-b2-Opti-inj1/2=123/124; RAW sample names 'OMV sample1..4 inj1/inj2' agree on sample grouping and injection order.

design_consistency.evidence: Recomputed: 4 sources (2 groups x 2 biological replicates), 2 technical replicates (inj1/inj2) each, 8 assays, fraction 1 (no fractionation in Methods), label-free. Biological replicate and technical replicate numbers match msf/RAW names; factor value constant within each source; no confounder beyond the inherent group-wise resuspension medium (PBS vs iodixanol), which is part of the preparation protocol.

omission_safety.evidence: Every non-reserved value traced to pride.json, manuscript Methods, file names or RAW headers; no strain, reagent, age or other unsupported specificity added. Producer's aOMV->SyBV reading independently confirmed by abstract ('artificial OMV that we have named SyBV') and Methods (iodixanol only in SyBV prep, PBS for OMV). No material evidence found omitted that a required/recommended column demands.

Well done.' exit 0; sdrf-tools check --offline -> CLEAN (0 hallucinated/mismatch) exit 0; sdrf-tools structure -> Structure OK exit 0; sdrf-tools score -> 100/100 exit 0.

findings.message: Values 'outer membrane vesicle' / 'synthetic membrane vesicle' are free text in a custom column.
findings.evidence: No vesicle GO term present in the offline cache; GO has 'bacterial extracellular vesicle' (GO:0097691, not verifiable offline) and 'cell outer membrane' (GO:0009279, cached in EFO import). SyBV are Sarkosyl/Na2CO3-purified outer membranes per Methods 2.3.
findings.correction: Optionally encode as NT=bacterial extracellular vesicle;AC=GO:0097691 (OMV) and NT=cell outer membrane;AC=GO:0009279 (SyBV) after OLS verification, or leave as free text.

findings.message: 'whole organism' describes the E. coli source rather than the analysed vesicle fraction.
findings.evidence: Allowed by template value list and spec example 'E. coli culture -> whole organism'; no closer fixed value exists for a subcellular/vesicle fraction.
findings.correction: Acceptable as is; optionally note the fraction via cellular component (already present).

findings.message: Optional comment[MS2 mass analyzer] omitted although Methods state MS/MS recorded at 30,000 resolution (Orbitrap).
findings.evidence: manuscript.txt section 2.8; template marks the column optional.
findings.correction: Optionally add comment[MS2 mass analyzer] = NT=orbitrap;AC=MS:1000484.

findings.message: RAW instrument sample names label all eight files 'OMV sample1-4'; the SyBV assignment of 119-124 rests on deposited .msf names (aOMV-Opti) plus Methods.
findings.evidence: raw_header_check.json sample_name for 119/120/123/124 = '2950 OMV sample3/4'; msf names 2950_aOMV-*-Opti-*; Methods: SyBV purified on iodixanol, OMV in PBS.
findings.correction: Add the iodixanol/PBS Methods support to the evidence manifest so the inference is explicit; no SDRF change needed.
